title: Looks Can Kill - EP
description:
IVE EP <Looks Can Kill>
IVE 携迷你专辑《Looks Can Kill》回归。自出道以来，IVE 始终以独属于自己的方式，不断刷新关于自信与自我确信的表达，如今的她们早已不再局限于单一的形象。从正规专辑《REVIVE+》到世界巡演，IVE 不仅进一步巩固了自己在韩国及全球市场的影响力，也一次次证明了当下所处的位置。本次迷你专辑立足于此刻的 IVE，以更加大胆、立体的方式，进一步拓展属于她们的音乐世界。
登场即宣告胜负，IVE 式 Girl Hero 的诞生
《Looks Can Kill》以“仅凭存在本身就能给予致命一击的英雄”为概念出发点。在延续 IVE 至今所展现的“Girl Fantasy”角色形象的同时，继丘比特与魔法少女之后，IVE 再次推出全新的另一重自我（Another Ego）——“Girl Hero”。作为一项衍生（Spin-off）企划，本次专辑为 IVE 一直以来构建的世界观开辟了全新的表达维度。
致命魅力降临的瞬间，《Looks Can Kill》
主打曲《Looks Can Kill》以最直观的方式展现了本张专辑的核心理念。歌曲描绘了这样一种存在：登场的瞬间，胜负便已揭晓。仅凭自身的存在就足以压倒对手，瞬间掌控全场的 IVE，正是这首歌所呈现的形象。《Looks Can Kill》以 IVE 独有的自信与主导力，诠释了掌控全场的决定性时刻。
歌曲以极具吸引力的合成器铺底节奏开场，厚重的贝斯、充满动感的鼓点与丰富饱满的电子音效层层递进，逐步营造出强劲的推进力。如果说过去的 IVE 清晰地展现了自信与自我确信的态度，那么这次的主打曲则将这一理念进一步推向新的高度，甚至将令人沉沦的魅惑瞬间，也转化为由 IVE 主导的叙事。经过桥段后，最后一段副歌以极具爆发力的方式震撼释放，不仅将整首歌的听觉快感推向顶点，也最鲜明地展现了如今的 IVE 将以怎样的面貌与姿态重新介绍自己。
六个场景，构成一张完整原声带般的专辑
收录曲同样各具特色，承担着不同的表达作用。《Mirror Mirror》巧妙地颠覆童话元素，以暗黑而梦幻的情绪拓展了专辑的整体风格；《SNAKESKIN》则描绘了褪去虚假、展现真实自我的蜕变过程。《CRUMBS》以厚重的贝斯和直观鲜明的节奏为基础，展现出将节拍牢牢掌握在自己手中的自信姿态；《Girls Girls Girls》通过自由、开放的氛围，为整张专辑注入轻盈的呼吸感；而《Glow Motion》则凭借梦幻且流畅自然的音效质感，让这张 EP 的余韵得到更加柔和的延伸。
值得关注的是，尽管每首歌曲都有着鲜明的个性，整张专辑却依然能够自然地串联成一个整体。从气势强劲、不断向前推进的曲目，到灵活转换氛围、舒展听觉体验的作品，《Looks Can Kill》并未将自己局限于单一的声音风格之中。而贯穿其中的共同特质，正是自信、掌控力，以及 IVE 始终鲜明而坚定的核心。
以 Spin-off 拓展世界观，以“Real HERO”完成蜕变
主打曲《Looks Can Kill》的音乐视频借鉴了英雄电影的叙事方式，展现了 IVE 作为扮演英雄的超级明星，同时也能在现实生活中产生影响力的多重面貌。通过穿梭于拍摄现场内外的镜头设计，IVE 自由而大胆地运用自身形象，将意义从“扮演英雄的 IVE”进一步延伸至“本身就是英雄的 IVE”。
与此同时，本次专辑也将目光投向了这样一个瞬间：人们对 IVE 的憧憬，逐渐转化为他人追逐梦想的动力与勇气。一个人的存在能够触动另一个人，而这份影响力又进一步引发新的改变。IVE 以独属于自己的英雄叙事，描绘了这一不断延伸的过程。
在收录曲《CRUMBS》的曲目视频 SPIN-OFF FILM 中，粉丝“DIVE”与 IVE 一同展开了一场想象中的越轨冒险。正如电影中的英雄即使走出银幕，也能为现实中的人们带来梦想与勇气，IVE 同样超越了剧情设定本身，进一步拓展了英雄的意义，成为能够在现实生活中带来积极改变的存在。IVE 所诠释的英雄，并非依靠特殊能力拯救世界的人，而是能够将梦想与勇气传递给他人，并激励他们继续向前迈进的存在。
超越成熟与完整，令人期待 IVE 下一阶段的专辑
IVE 已经用实力证明了许多。从出道初期留下的强烈印象出发，她们并未停留在最初的成功之中，而是通过一首首热门歌曲、一张张专辑、一次次舞台表演与世界巡演，不断巩固属于自己的地位。如今的 IVE，早已无法仅凭一时的话题热度来定义。她们清楚地了解自身的身份与特色，也能够以最贴近大众的语言和最具感知力的方式，不断拓展自身的表达边界。
在这一发展脉络之上，《Looks Can Kill》并未简单重复 IVE 已经熟练掌握的优势，而是尝试通过更加多元的音乐质感，展现她们与生俱来的自信。从强劲的记忆点与充满速度感的节奏，到奇幻色彩、自我欣赏，再到释放感与蜕变叙事，这张专辑证明了 IVE 并非只拥有一套成功公式的团体，而是一支能够持续拓展并不断赋予既有公式全新变化的团队。
因此，这张专辑既诠释了当下的 IVE，也让人更加期待她们的未来。她们不满足于停留在唯一的标准答案之中，而是持续拓展自己的世界，在形象与音乐两个层面不断创造全新的篇章。《Looks Can Kill》将成为最鲜明的证明，展现 IVE 正站在无限可能性之上，向着下一个阶段继续前进。
IVE EP <Looks Can Kill> TRACKLIST
01 Looks Can Kill *Title
Lyrics by Gaeko, 서지음, Lil Cherry, 레이, Rick Bridges
Rap Making by 레이, Rick Bridges
Composed by Charles Roberts Nelsen, BAVA, Ashley Fulton, Jason Hahs, MLITE
Arranged by Inverness, BAVA
《Looks Can Kill》是一首电子舞曲流行风格的歌曲，以抓耳的合成器铺底节奏开场，在厚重而粗粝的贝斯之上，动感十足的鼓点与丰富的电子音效元素和谐交融，营造出自信从容、气场十足的氛围。尤其是经过扭转整体氛围的桥段后，最后一段副歌以爆发性的能量强势迸发，为听众带来畅快淋漓的感官冲击与极致的情绪释放。
02 Mirror Mirror
Lyrics by 서지음
Composed by Joshua Linne, Nikolay Mohr, Blush Davis, Miranda Glory Inzunza, Natania Lalwani, MLITE
Arranged by FriendsFromCollege
《Mirror Mirror》是一首充满暗黑与梦幻气息的小调风格作品，巧妙运用莫扎特《E小调第21号小提琴奏鸣曲》，为歌曲的开篇与尾声营造出强烈的听觉冲击。钢琴与弦乐贯穿全曲，引领着歌曲的情绪走向，间或响起的铃音与松弛慵懒的演唱音色相互交织，营造出独特而令人不寒而栗的诡谲氛围，展现出这首概念性曲目的鲜明魅力。
03 SNAKESKIN
Lyrics by 서지음
Composed by Jack Brady, Jordan Roman, Kristine Bogan, Lauren Aquilina, MLITE
Arranged by The Wavys
《SNAKESKIN》是一首以低沉且富有冲击力的贝斯与独特合成器音色为亮点的作品。在强劲的节奏之上，神秘而迷离的人声与旋律层层铺展，留下鲜明而深刻的印象。从简约精致的前半段，到后半段逐渐转向 EDM 音效，整首歌通过精心设计、层层递进的编排，将作品的魅力进一步推向极致。
04 CRUMBS
Lyrics by 이스란, 오메가사피엔, Lil Cherry, 조윤경, 가을, 리즈
Composed by Jhune, Evan Gartner, Gabriella Grombacher, MLITE
Arranged by Jhune, Evan Gartner
《CRUMBS》是一首以极具律动感的贝斯线为亮点的电子舞曲流行作品，通过厚重的底鼓与合成器铺底音色相互交融，营造出简约却层次丰富的声音质感。尤其是令人一听便萦绕耳畔的抓耳旋律线，搭配丰富多变的和声、即兴演唱等多元人声元素，进一步放大了歌曲的独特魅力。
05 Girls Girls Girls
Lyrics by 서지음
Composed by Kevin Hickey, Samuel Robert Knowles, Alna Hofmeyr, CASTLE, Sarah Hudson, MLITE
Arranged by Zhone, Karma Kid
《Girls Girls Girls》是一首流行舞曲，以轻松自在的节奏和从第一个音符开始便牢牢抓住听众耳朵的上瘾系合成器音效为亮点。在富有律动感的编曲之上，明亮轻快的人声为歌曲注入清新又充满活力的氛围，呈现出令人耳目一新的音乐魅力。
06 Glow Motion
Lyrics by 조윤경
Composed by Zara Larsson, Caila Betsy Nell Thompson Hannant, Margo Wildman, MLITE
Arranged by Caila Betsy Nell Thompson Hannant, Margo Wildman
这首作品由全球流行音乐艺人 Zara Larsson，以及参与其专辑《Midnight Sun》全曲创作的制作人 Margo XS 与 Cecile Believe 共同打造。歌曲以细腻而梦幻的氛围为基底，将令人联想到自然的有机感合成器音效与精致的流行音乐制作巧妙融合，通过柔和的旋律线营造出神秘而引人沉浸的听觉体验。这是一首展现 IVE 不同于以往的音乐风格、进一步拓展其音乐表现边界的流行作品。

brief:
IVE EP <Looks Can Kill>
IVE 携迷你专辑《Looks Can Kill》回归。自出道以来，IVE 始终以独属于自己的方式，不断刷新关于自信与自我确信的表达，如今的她们早已不再局限于单一的形象。从正规专辑《REVIVE+》到世界巡演，IVE 不仅进一步巩固了自己在韩国及全球市场的影响力，也一次次证明了当下所处的位置。本次迷你专辑立足于此刻的 IVE，以更加大胆、立体的方式，进一步拓展属于她们的音乐世界。
登场即宣告胜负，IVE 式 Girl Hero 的诞生
《Looks Can Kill》以“仅凭存在本身就能给予致命一击的英雄”为概念出发点。在延续 IVE 至今所展现的“Girl Fantasy”角色形象的同时，继丘比特与魔法少女之后，IVE 再次推出全新的另一重自我（Another Ego）——“Girl Hero”。作为一项衍生（Spin-off）企划，本次专辑为 IVE 一直以来构建的世界观开辟了全新的表达维度。
致命魅力降临的瞬间，《Looks Can Kill》
主打曲《Looks Can Kill》以最直观的方式展现了本张专辑的核心理念。歌曲描绘了这样一种存在：登场的瞬间，胜负便已揭晓。仅凭自身的存在就足以压倒对手，瞬间掌控全场的 IVE，正是这首歌所呈现的形象。《Looks Can Kill》以 IVE 独有的自信与主导力，诠释了掌控全场的决定性时刻。
歌曲以极具吸引力的合成器铺底节奏开场，厚重的贝斯、充满动感的鼓点与丰富饱满的电子音效层层递进，逐步营造出强劲的推进力。如果说过去的 IVE 清晰地展现了自信与自我确信的态度，那么这次的主打曲则将这一理念进一步推向新的高度，甚至将令人沉沦的魅惑瞬间，也转化为由 IVE 主导的叙事。经过桥段后，最后一段副歌以极具爆发力的方式震撼释放，不仅将整首歌的听觉快感推向顶点，也最鲜明地展现了如今的 IVE 将以怎样的面貌与姿态重新介绍自己。
六个场景，构成一张完整原声带般的专辑
收录曲同样各具特色，承担着不同的表达作用。《Mirror Mirror》巧妙地颠覆童话元素，以暗黑而梦幻的情绪拓展了专辑的整体风格；《SNAKESKIN》则描绘了褪去虚假、展现真实自我的蜕变过程。《CRUMBS》以厚重的贝斯和直观鲜明的节奏为基础，展现出将节拍牢牢掌握在自己手中的自信姿态；《Girls Girls Girls》通过自由、开放的氛围，为整张专辑注入轻盈的呼吸感；而《Glow Motion》则凭借梦幻且流畅自然的音效质感，让这张 EP 的余韵得到更加柔和的延伸。
值得关注的是，尽管每首歌曲都有着鲜明的个性，整张专辑却依然能够自然地串联成一个整体。从气势强劲、不断向前推进的曲目，到灵活转换氛围、舒展听觉体验的作品，《Looks Can Kill》并未将自己局限于单一的声音风格之中。而贯穿其中的共同特质，正是自信、掌控力，以及 IVE 始终鲜明而坚定的核心。
以 Spin-off 拓展世界观，以“Real HERO”完成蜕变
主打曲《Looks Can Kill》的音乐视频借鉴了英雄电影的叙事方式，展现了 IVE 作为扮演英雄的超级明星，同时也能在现实生活中产生影响力的多重面貌。通过穿梭于拍摄现场内外的镜头设计，IVE 自由而大胆地运用自身形象，将意义从“扮演英雄的 IVE”进一步延伸至“本身就是英雄的 IVE”。
与此同时，本次专辑也将目光投向了这样一个瞬间：人们对 IVE 的憧憬，逐渐转化为他人追逐梦想的动力与勇气。一个人的存在能够触动另一个人，而这份影响力又进一步引发新的改变。IVE 以独属于自己的英雄叙事，描绘了这一不断延伸的过程。
在收录曲《CRUMBS》的曲目视频 SPIN-OFF FILM 中，粉丝“DIVE”与 IVE 一同展开了一场想象中的越轨冒险。正如电影中的英雄即使走出银幕，也能为现实中的人们带来梦想与勇气，IVE 同样超越了剧情设定本身，进一步拓展了英雄的意义，成为能够在现实生活中带来积极改变的存在。IVE 所诠释的英雄，并非依靠特殊能力拯救世界的人，而是能够将梦想与勇气传递给他人，并激励他们继续向前迈进的存在。
超越成熟与完整，令人期待 IVE 下一阶段的专辑
IVE 已经用实力证明了许多。从出道初期留下的强烈印象出发，她们并未停留在最初的成功之中，而是通过一首首热门歌曲、一张张专辑、一次次舞台表演与世界巡演，不断巩固属于自己的地位。如今的 IVE，早已无法仅凭一时的话题热度来定义。她们清楚地了解自身的身份与特色，也能够以最贴近大众的语言和最具感知力的方式，不断拓展自身的表达边界。
在这一发展脉络之上，《Looks Can Kill》并未简单重复 IVE 已经熟练掌握的优势，而是尝试通过更加多元的音乐质感，展现她们与生俱来的自信。从强劲的记忆点与充满速度感的节奏，到奇幻色彩、自我欣赏，再到释放感与蜕变叙事，这张专辑证明了 IVE 并非只拥有一套成功公式的团体，而是一支能够持续拓展并不断赋予既有公式全新变化的团队。
因此，这张专辑既诠释了当下的 IVE，也让人更加期待她们的未来。她们不满足于停留在唯一的标准答案之中，而是持续拓展自己的世界，在形象与音乐两个层面不断创造全新的篇章。《Looks Can Kill》将成为最鲜明的证明，展现 IVE 正站在无限可能性之上，向着下一个阶段继续前进。

title: OK Computer
description: 前兩張作品為 Radiohead 打開了市場並獲得廣泛關注，《OK Computer》則真正宣告 Radiohead 成為了 90 年代最具代表性的偉大樂團之一。與前作《The Bends》以吉他為主、抒情自省的風格不同，《OK Computer》抽象而模糊、密集而獨特的聲音成為樂團新的標籤，也為後續實驗性作品奠定基調。專輯發行後即如風暴般迅速攻占各大排行榜，並贏得第 40 屆葛萊美「最佳另類音樂專輯」獎，《OK Computer》脫去了傳統搖滾的外衣，重新審視著英倫搖滾，Thom Yorke 的嗓音從溫暖細膩的假聲轉變成歇斯底里的釋放，更為複雜的歌曲結構則加入了電子元素襯托，在極度迷幻的氛圍下仍然能嗅出搖滾的痕跡。從開篇〈Airbag〉中的 riff 與電子聲效交錯，到終曲〈The Tourist〉Thom Yorke 想要放慢腳步的懇求，每一首歌都是專輯精神的講述，如同腦海中交錯出現的關於生死、科技與社會不可避免的矛盾對話；〈Fitter Happier〉更是為專輯概念點睛，歌曲中機械化的語音播報，道出電腦時代下人類看似差不多的生活方式，冰冷生硬的聲音中帶著諷刺意味。《OK Computer》不僅是 Radiohead 的靈魂所在，也是他們對於時代的反思，更是搖滾史上無可磨滅的經典。

localized_description.text: The pop singer’s full-length debut is a bold and uproarious introduction, buoyed by sturdy songcraft and steely indifference to good taste.

来自密苏里州的新星 Chappell Roan 并不介意事无巨细地唱出她的所感所想。继动人的首支单曲《Good Hurt》引起关注之后，在这次的首张专辑《The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess》里，她讲述了一个个关于放纵与绝望的故事，也完整记录了逐渐明晰自身酷儿身份、决心活出自信人生的心路历程。

在专辑的开场曲中，Roan 先是伴着钢琴的颤音、美妙的和声，悲伤地讲起自己遇人不淑的过往；随着节拍逐渐加强，具有力量感的高昂声调最终主宰了整首歌曲，她也意识到自己需要成为“女性现象”（Femininomenon）的一份子，应该获得尊重，追求属于自己的快乐。接下来的 13 首歌，都采用了这种“急转直上”的结构。Synth-Pop 风格的《Casual》异常诚实地剖析了一段非正式关系；没心没肺的舞曲《Super Graphic Ultra Modern Girl》带着不屑，吐槽了一个“超级超级讨厌的男孩”（hyper mega bummer boys），以讽刺的独白开场，在欢腾的合唱中收尾。Roan 也没有忘记抒情歌的老本行：她在《California》里低吟浅唱，与乡愁和沮丧缠斗；在曲风华丽的《Coffee》里道尽关系里的犹豫与分手的艰难。

无论是笑里藏刀的《My Kink Is Karma》，还是挑逗意味十足的《Red Wine Supernova》，Roan 的音乐总是伴着渴望，就连调性内敛的作品也不例外，欲望觉醒也让 Roan 的人生豁然开朗，但归根结底，“性”只是欲望的一部分。无论是福是祸，Chappell Roan 都极尽诚实地面对自身复杂的感受，再加上大胆新奇的创想，让这张流行专辑令人欲罢不能。

Chappell Roan is not afraid to tell you—or, really, sing at you—about how she's feeling, in vivid detail. On her debut album, the Missouri-born upstart, who has been making waves since the 2017 release of her intense debut single “Good Hurt,” collects tales of debauchery and despair as it chronicles her realization of being queer and coming into her own. The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess opens with Roan singing mournfully about a dastardly ex-boyfriend over trembling pianos and starlit choirs; an insistent beat rises up gradually at first, then overtakes the song as she realizes she needs to be part of a “Femininomenon” that demands pleasure and respect from anyone lucky enough to be in her orbit. Left turns like that abound over the next 13 songs. Take the synth-pop “Casual,” which dissects a friends-with-benefits relationship in brutally specific detail, or the euphoric club cut “Super Graphic Ultra Modern Girl,” an insouciant dismissal of “hyper mega bummer boys” that opens with a sardonic mini-monologue and closes with a triumphant sing-along. Roan still traffics in ballads, too: “California” grapples with homesickness and frustration, Roan dipping down into her voice's low reaches, while the plush “Coffee” examines the idea of fully closing the loop with an ex, with the reality of its impossibility closing in as the music swells. There's a hunger that drives Roan's music, even in its more introspective moments. It isn't just sexual, although songs like the smirking poison-pen letter “My Kink Is Karma” and the flirty electro-psych come-on “Red Wine Supernova” show off how Roan's erotic awakening has helped her whole outlook on life come into sharp relief. Her willingness to take pop in unexpected directions, combined with her frankness about the tangled feelings that arise even when good things seem to be happening, make her debut compulsively listenable.
Une pop éclatée, festive, coquine et résolument queer.

description:
[뉴스엔 이민지 기자] 리센느(RESCENE)가 오는 11월 3일 미니 4집 ‘PULSE’(펄스)를 발매한다.
소속사 더뮤즈엔터테인먼트에 따르면 리센느(원이, 리브, 미나미, 메이, 제나)는 이날 새 앨범을 공개하고 컴백 활동에 돌입한다.
이는 지난 7월 리메이크 싱글 ‘Pretty Girl’(프리티 걸)을 발표한 이후 약 4개월 만의 신보다. 실물 앨범 기준으로는 지난해 11월 공개한 미니 3집 ‘lip bomb’(립밤) 이후 약 1년 만이다.
리센느는 올해 원이의 개인 유튜브 채널을 통해 유행어로 떠오른 '거제 야호' 인기에 힘입어 대세 그룹으로 떠올랐다. 2024년 8월 발매한 미니 1집 ‘SCENEDROME’(씬드롬) 타이틀곡 ‘LOVE ATTACK’(러브 어택)으로 역주행한데 이어 'Pretty Girl'이 정주행을 이어가며 대세 걸그룹으로 자리매김했다.
한편 리센느는 그동안 앨범마다 ‘풀 향’, ‘베리 향’, ‘인센스향’ 등 향기를 활용한 콘셉트를 선보여왔다. 미니 4집 ‘PULSE’에서는 어떤 향기와 음악으로 기존 색깔을 확장할지 관심이 쏠린다.

title: DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS
description: Scores of Puerto Rican artists have used their music to express love and pride in their island, but few do so with the same purposeful vigor as Bad Bunny. The superstar from Vega Baja is responsible for numerous songs that center his homeland, from unofficial national anthems like “Estamos Bien” and “El Apagón” to powerful posse cuts like “ACHO PR” with veteran reggaetón luminaries Arcángel, De La Ghetto, and Ñengo Flow. More recently, he’s been decidedly direct about his passions and concerns, expressed in vivid detail on 2024’s standalone single “Una Velita.” Positioned as his sixth proper studio album, DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS centers Puerto Rico in his work more so than before, celebrating various musical styles within its legacy. While 2023’s nadie sabe lo que va a pasar mañana validated his trapero past with a more modern take on the sound he emerged with in the 2010s, this follow-up largely diverges from hip-hop, demonstrating his apparent aversion to repeating himself from album to album. Instead, house music morphs into plena on “EL CLúB,” the latter genre resurfacing later in splendorous fashion on “CAFé CON RON” with Los Pleneros de la Cresta. Befitting its title, “VOY A LLeVARTE PA PR” is set to a sleek reggaetón rhythm for prime-time perreo vibes, as is also the case for “KETU TeCRÉ” and the relatively more rugged “EoO.” A bold salsa statement, “BAILE INoLVIDABLE” pays apparent homage to some seminal Fania releases by Willie Colón and Héctor Lavoe, with traces of the instrumental interplay of “Juanito Alimaña” and an irresistible coda reminiscent to that of “Periódico de Ayer.” Regardless of style, the political and the personal thematically blur throughout the album, a new year’s gloom hanging over “PIToRRO DE COCO” and a metaphorical wound left open after the poignant “TURISTA.” As before, Bad Bunny remains an excellent and inventive collaborator, linking here primarily with other Puerto Ricans as more than a mere symbolic gesture. Sociopolitically minded indie group Chuwi join for the eclectic and vibrant “WELTiTA,” its members providing melodic vocals that both complement and magnify those of their host. Carolina natives Dei V and Omar Courtz form a formidable trio for the thumping dancehall retrofuturism of “VeLDÁ,” while RaiNao proves an exceedingly worthy duet partner on “PERFuMITO NUEVO.”

纵观乐坛，许多波多黎各音乐人都曾用各自的方式表达着对海岛故乡的眷恋与热爱，但很少有人像 Bad Bunny 爱得那么热烈持续。从号称是“波多黎各非官方国歌”的《Estamos Bien》《El Apagón》，到其与 Reggaetón 巨擘 Arcángel、De La Ghetto 和 Ñengo Flow 共同打造的高能接力曲目《ACHO PR》，这位来自中北部海岸下维加（Vega Baja）的流行巨星创作了无数写给故土的歌曲。2024 年，以单曲形式发布的《Una Velita》借飓风“玛利亚”重创波多黎各一事，生动地描绘了一代人的挫败感，直白表露出 Bad Bunny 内心深处对故乡的热爱和担忧。他的第六张录音室专辑《DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS》比以往有过之而无不及，深度立足波多黎各，演绎了多种音乐风格，以彰显当地丰富的音乐遗产。

发行于 2023 年的前作《nadie sabe lo que va a pasar mañana》以更贴合当下的曲风，回溯了 Bad Bunny 以 Latin Trap 音乐人身份崭露头角的 2010 年代，但这张续作显然在很大程度上偏离了 Hip-Hop，表明了他不愿在一张张专辑中重复自己的决心。于是，波多黎各的 Plena 音乐在与 Los Pleneros de la Cresta 乐队合作的《CAFé CON RON》里华丽登场，并在《EL CLúB》里与 House 曲风相互结合。意为“我要带你去波多黎各”的《VOY A LLeVARTE PA PR》恰如其名，通过流畅的 Reggaetón 节奏巧妙迎合了 Perreo 舞池的纵情声色，《KETU TeCRÉ》和粗犷的《EoO》也如法炮制。《BAILE INoLVIDABLE》是一首大胆的 Salsa 舞曲，意图致敬 Salsa 界最具标志性的二人组 Willie Colón 和 Héctor Lavoe，以及二人通过 Fania Records 发行的极具时代开创性的专辑。这首歌的器乐配合与 1983 年发行的《Juanito Alimaña》一脉相承，而其令人难以抗拒的结尾令人想起 Héctor Lavoe 的另一首经典《Periódico de Ayer》。抛开风格不谈，整张专辑中，政治和个人主题相互交织，新年的阴霾笼罩着《PIToRRO DE COCO》，凄美的《TURiSTA》过后，留下了一个隐喻的伤口。

Bad Bunny 一如既往地富有创造力，擅长与人合作。这张专辑中，他与众多同胞音乐人的合作不仅仅是一种象征性的姿态，更是一趟心灵契合的奇妙旅程。活力满满的《WELTiTA》邀来社会政治意识强烈的独立乐队 Chuwi，乐队成员的和声旋律优美，更映衬出 Bad Bunny 主导的人声之美妙。来自波多黎各卡罗利纳的 Dei V 和 Omar Courtz 共同打造了《VeLDÁ》，呈现了复古未来主义 Dancehall 风格的三重奏，RaiNao 则在《PERFuMITO NUEVO》的二重唱中证明了自己的独特魅力。

Le groupe indé Chuwi, se joint à lui sur l’éclectique et animé « WELTiTA », ses membres apportant des voix mélodieuses qui complètent et amplifient parfaitement celle de Bad Bunny. 多くのプエルトリコ出身アーティストが音楽を通して島への愛や誇りを表現してきたが、バッド・バニーほど目的意識を持って力強く表現している人はほとんどいないだろう。ベガ・バハ出身のこのスーパースターは、まるで国歌のような「Estamos Bien」や「El Apagón」から、レゲトンの先駆者であるArcángel、De La Ghetto、Nengo Flowと共演した「ACHO PR」をはじめとするパワフルな楽曲まで、故郷をテーマにした曲を数多く手掛けている。近年は自身の情熱や懸念について率直に語るようになり、2024年のシングル「Una Velita」では、その詳細を鮮明に表現している。そして、彼にとって6作目の正式なスタジオアルバムとなる『DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS』は、これまで以上にプエルトリコに焦点を当てた作品であり、プエルトリコに受け継がれる多様な音楽スタイルをたたえている。

2023年のアルバム『nadie sabe lo que va a pasar mañana』が、2010年代に登場した当時の彼のサウンドをより現代的に解釈し、ラテントラップシーンをけん引してきた過去を立証した一方で、続く今作はヒップホップから大きく逸脱しており、アルバムごとに同じものを繰り返すことへの彼の嫌悪感が明示されている。その代わりに、「EL CLúB」ではハウスミュージックがプエルトリコの音楽であるプレナへと変化しており、プレナは後にLos Pleneros de la Crestaとの「CAFé CON RON」で華麗に再登場する。「VOY A LLeVARTE PA PR」はそのタイトルにふさわしく、ゴールデンタイムのペレオ（レゲトンの音楽に合わせて踊るダンス）のヴァイブスを醸し出す洗練されたレゲトンのリズムに設定されており、それは「KETU TeCRÉ」や比較的荒々しい「EoO」も同様だ。大胆なサルサを主張する「BAILE INoLVIDABLE」は、Willie Colónとエクトル・ラボーがFania Recordsからリリースした独創的な作品の数々に明らかなオマージュを捧げており、「Juanito Alimaña」のインストゥルメンタル・インタープレイの痕跡と、「Periódico De Ayer」を想起させる魅力的なコーダが含まれている。また、スタイルにかかわらずアルバム全体を通して政治的なテーマと個人的なテーマが交錯しており、「PIToRRO DE COCO」では恋人と別れて迎えた新年に漂う憂鬱（ゆううつ）を歌い、「TURiSTA」では別れた恋人の存在を観光客に例え、その痛々しい傷が余韻を残す。

また、今作でもこれまでと同様に、バッド・バニーは優れた独創的なコラボレーターであり、単なる象徴的な形だけのものにとどまることなく、プエルトリコ出身のアーティストたちを中心にタッグを組んでいる。社会政治的な考えを持つインディーグループのChuwiが、折衷的で活気に満ちた「WELTiTA」に参加し、メンバーが披露するメロディアスなボーカルがバッド・バニーの歌声を補完して引き立てる。また、カロリーナ出身のDei VとOmar Courtzとは、ズンズンとビートが響くダンスホールレトロフューチャーの「VeLDÁ」で強力なトリオぶりを発揮し、「PERFuMITO NUEVO」ではRaiNaoがバッド・バニーのデュエットのパートナーとして極めてふさわしいことを示している。

많은 푸에르토리코 출신 아티스트가 음악으로 고향에 대한 사랑과 자부심을 표현해 왔습니다. 하지만 Bad Bunny만큼 그런 마음을 의도적으로 강하게 표출하는 아티스트는 드물죠. 푸에르토리코 베가 바하 출신인 그는 고국을 중심에 둔 수많은 곡을 발표해 왔습니다. 'Estamos Bien'이나 'El Apagón' 같은 국민적 인기곡, 그리고 레게톤 거장인 Arcángel, De La Ghetto, Ñengo Flow와 함께한 강렬한 협업곡 'ACHO PR'이 대표적입니다. 그리고 2024년 싱글 'Una Velita'에서는 고국을 향한 열정과 사회적 문제에 대한 고민을 생생하게 드러냈습니다. 이후 발매된 이번 정규 6집 'DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS'는 그 어느 때보다 푸에르토리코의 다양한 음악적 유산을 기리는 데 초점을 맞춘 작품입니다.

2023년 작 'nadie sabe lo que va a pasar mañana'는 Bad Bunny의 과거 시절을 재조명한 앨범이었습니다. 그는 이 작품에서 활동 초기인 2010년대에 추구했던 트랩 사운드를 현대적으로 재해석했죠. 반면 앨범 'DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS'는 힙합에서 벗어나 새로운 음악적 방향을 모색합니다. 이는 Bad Bunny가 앨범마다 과거를 답습하지 않는다는 걸 증명하죠. 'EL CLúB'에서는 하우스 음악과 푸에르토리코 전통 음악 장르인 플레나의 융합을 시도했습니다. 플레나는 Los Pleneros de la Cresta와 함께한 'CAFé CON RON'에서 더욱 화려한 모습으로 재등장합니다. 한편, 'VOY A LLeVARTE PA PR'은 '당신을 푸에르토리코로 데려가겠어요'라는 제목 뜻에 걸맞게 매끄러운 레게톤 리듬 위에 정통 페레오의 분위기를 더했습니다. 'KETU TeCRÉ'와 보다 거친 느낌의 'EoO'에서도 이런 감각은 이어집니다. 과감한 살사 'BAILE INoLVIDABLE'은 살사 음악의 황금기를 이끈 Willie Colón과 Héctor Lavoe의 Fania Records 시절 대표작이 연상되는 곡입니다. 특히 'Juanito Alimaña'의 악기 편곡 스타일과 'Periódico de Ayer'의 매혹적인 코다에서 영감을 받은 듯한 요소들이 보이죠. 음악적 스타일과는 관계없이, 이번 앨범엔 정치적 주제와 개인적 이야기가 자연스럽게 섞여 있습니다. 'PIToRRO DE COCO'에서는 새로운 한 해를 맞이하는 무거운 감정이 드러나고, 'TURiSTA'는 가슴 시린 심리적 상처를 다루며 깊은 여운을 전합니다.

Bad Bunny는 이번에도 탁월하고 창의적인 아티스트이자 협업자로서 빛을 발합니다. 단순히 상징적 의미에 그치지 않고, 여러 푸에르토리코 출신 아티스트와의 협업을 통해 진정성을 보여주죠. 사회정치적 메시지를 전하는 인디 그룹 Chuwi는 다채롭고 생동감 넘치는 'WELTiTA'에 참여했습니다. Chuwi가 들려주는 감미로운 보컬은 Bad Bunny의 음색과 어우러져 시너지를 냅니다. 'VeLDÁ'에는 캐롤라이나 출신 Dei V와 Omar Courtz가 참여했습니다. 이들은 Bad Bunny와 함께 강렬한 비트와 미래지향적 요소를 결합한 댄스홀을 완성했죠. RaiNao는 'PERFuMITO NUEVO'에서 매력적인 듀엣 파트너로 활약합니다.

title: I Love My Computer
description: Nina Wilson, aka Central Coast-born DJ and producer Ninajirachi, was six or seven songs into writing her debut album when she noticed a through line. “I started to find little points that connected [them] being about my childhood, or being about my computer, so that was when I came up with the title,” she tells Apple Music. “From there, it made it really easy to finish the rest of the tracks because that was my scaffold.” With some ideas on the album stretching back to voice memos from 2019, Wilson has spent years methodically building a sonic world that incorporates elements of 2000s electroclash (“London Song”), trance (“Infohazard”), and club (“CSIRAC”) into her melodic dance-music blueprint. Also showing through is the influence of early 2010s Australian dance artists such as PNAU, Empire Of The Sun, and Miami Horror, particularly in songs such as “All I Am” and “iPod Touch.” “I guess that’s the palette or the world, but I also didn’t want to be too reverential,” she says. “That’s the music that was most inspiring to me when I started making music, but I’ve definitely wanted to make my own version of it.” Here, Wilson takes Apple Music through I Love My Computer, track by track. “London Song” “This was not about anything at first, it was just a voice memo. I wrote the singing part with the extra lyrics, and by that point I had the title of the album and was like, ‘OK, I need to make this about my computer.’ And the way I twisted it was, almost all the places I’ve been overseas is because I made music on a laptop. And that’s what allowed me to go there. So that’s the way I reframed the random voice memo—I would go with you [to London], with my computer that has afforded me that luxury.” “iPod Touch” “When I was in high school, I got really into electronic music, but also pretty niche SoundCloud electronic music, and I didn’t have any friends that were into it. It felt like all my favorite songs were my secrets, ’cause I didn’t have anyone to share them with. In that song, there’s a reference to a Porter Robinson track from 2012 that was my favorite song when I was 12 or however old I was.” “F**k My Computer” “I use Ableton to produce my music. I was using other software before that, and when I landed on Ableton, I felt like it was the first interface I meshed with and I started becoming really fast. Sometimes, I think, ‘How could I get faster? How could I widen the bandwidth even more?’ It’s just a hardware limitation at this point, I just need to insert my brain into the computer. If we were just one entity, I wouldn’t have to lose ideas in translation.” “CSIRAC” “CSIRAC is the first computer in the world to ever [play digital] music. I felt like the album was missing more of a clubby, drummy, DJ moment, and I thought this could be that.” “Delete” “The song is about when you have a crush and you post a photo just for them to see it. It’s a little Gatsby-ish, like you put on this big show for just one person to see it. And then you’re like, ‘Have they seen it? Do they think I’m pretty?’ Then it’s the self-awareness of being like, ‘I’m so embarrassing!’” “ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ” “It’s a cat symbol. Internally we’ve been calling it ‘Cat Face.’ Or ‘Cat Interlude.’ It’s just an interlude to ‘All I Am.’ Originally, ‘All I Am’ had a long, progressive intro. But when it came to releasing it on its own, it felt too indulgent; it felt too much like two songs in one to work as a single. So I split that intro off to make it its own song.” “All I Am” “This was such a special song to make. It was a jam at Ben Lee’s house in LA with Ben, Jenna [McDougall, aka Hevenshe], Alex [Greenwald, Phantom Planet], and Maz [DeVita, WAAX]. We were literally recording anything. Then we had a break, and we had a little bit of a microdose, and had lunch, and then everyone got sleepy. We all got into this meditative state, and I just started looping certain parts of what we’d recorded and added my own elements on top of their audio, and it just built into this dance progression thing. I think a lot of the music I was listening to at the time, like PNAU, really leaked through in that second half of the session where I started working on it on its own.” “Infohazard” “I saw this artwork of this girl sitting next to a computer and she was cute, kind of Bratz doll style. And the text said, ‘Help, I’m online and I just saw a beheading.’ And I was like, ‘Oh yeah, that happened to me when I was a cute girl too.’ It just seemed like an interesting way to make light of what is probably a shared trauma amongst people of my generation. If not a beheading they’ve just been scrolling and been like, ‘Oh, I probably wasn’t meant to see that and I can’t forget about it now.’” “Battery Death” “I really wanted to have a halftime, more hip-hop-drums track so it wasn’t all just four-to-the-floor dance music. I think I was reading a lot about battery life, but no one was really talking about battery death. It just sounded like a funny title but worked in with the themes of the album.” “Sing Good” “It started as a gibberish jam, and I started mumbling, ‘I can’t really sing.’ I thought, that’s kind of funny. I don’t know if I’ve heard someone write about not being able to sing. I was writing music before I was producing it—like I say in the lyrics, I would get the lyric books of my favorite albums and be like, ‘What’s a verse? What’s a chorus? Oh OK, this is the formula,’ and that’s how I wrote about it. I would just write songs about going to the shops and stuff but never really show them to anyone ’cause I wasn’t a good singer.” “It’s You” (with daine) “daine was having a really bad day and we were trying to make music but they weren’t feeling super good. I was a little bit pushy—I was very gentle but I was like, ‘Let’s record something.’ So we just did this one little recording, this one gibberish take, and it ended up being the song. Later, when daine was feeling better, we put lyrics to it and rerecorded it. I’m so glad we pushed it that day.” “All at Once” “The verse at the end is about, I’m always at my desk in the dark, always working by myself late at night at the computer—that’s where I get the best work done a lot of the time. I wanted to send off the album with the last devotional nod to everything my computer had done for me, good and bad. It’s allowed me to have this crazy career that I wouldn’t have been allowed to have if I didn’t grow up in this decade. It would have been totally different.”

description: Adele怀着极其复杂的心情公布了她的全新片 “21”，这张新专辑将明年1月24日在英国地区发行，二月底在北美地区发行。随着发行专辑前，新专辑里第一首单曲 “Rolling In the Deep” 会于1月16日公布，这张新专辑大部分录制工作是在美国 Malibu 完成，并与传奇性唱片制作人Rick Rubin（ Johnny Cash, Jay Z, Red Hot Chilli Peppers ）一同合作，后期是她回到伦敦后与制作人Paul Epworth ( Plan B, Bloc Party, Florence )负责完成, 按照Adele自己的方式，这是一张有着忧郁的布鲁斯、福音和Disco的风格作品。 对于新专辑她如此说道，“关于‘21’,我感觉非常兴奋、紧张、热烈渴望甚至也有些焦虑，但很开心在这里向大家公布，我花了很长一段时间。新专辑和两年前的‘19’会有所不同，因为我现在处理的创作方式和心态也不同于以前，我现在变得更有耐心，更诚恳，更宽恕也更能意识到自己的不足，一些个人习性和原则所在。我想一些事情也是伴随着年龄而不断发生的，所以新专辑贴切的命名为‘21’，我的第一专辑以‘19’命名原因也是如此，像是关于我自己的一个目录一样，所有发生在自己身上的一切事物，就像是以照片的方式一样在记录着我个人这些年来的成长发展和改变。” 这两年来她也听取了来自许多不同音乐人的作品，特别是像Wanda Jackson, Allison Krauss, Yvonne Fair, Andrew Bird, Neko Case等。有关于专辑“21”的创作灵感，她还列下了一长串的音乐人名字表示对他们的热烈敬爱，像Mary J Blige, Mos Def, Elbow, Tom Waits, Kanye West, Alanis Morissette和Sinead O’Connor等等

title: Blonde
description:
On February 21, 2013, Ocean confirmed that he had started work on his second studio album, which he confirmed would be another concept album. He revealed that he was working with Tyler, The Creator, Pharrell Williams, and Danger Mouse on the record.He later stated that he was being influenced by The Beach Boys and The Beatles. He stated he was interested in collaborating with Tame Impala and King Krule and that he would record part of the album in Bora Bora.
In April 2014, Ocean stated that his second album was nearly finished. In June 2014, Billboard reported that the singer was working with a string of artists such as Happy Perez (whom he worked with on nostalgia, ULTRA), Charlie Gambetta and Kevin Ristro, while producers Hit-Boy, Rodney Jerkins and Danger Mouse were also said to be on board.[5][6] On November 29, 2014, Ocean released a snippet of a new song supposedly from his upcoming follow-up to channel ORANGE called "Memrise" on his official Tumblr page. The Guardian described the song as: "a song which affirms that despite reportedly changing labels and management, he has maintained both his experimentation and sense of melancholy in the intervening years". On April 6, 2015, Ocean announced that his follow-up to channel ORANGE would be released in July, as well as a publication, although no further details were released. The album was ultimately not released in July, with no explanation given for its delay. The publication is rumored to be called Boys Don't Cry, and the album is slated to feature the aforementioned "Memrise".
On July 2, 2016, he hinted at a possible second album with an image on his website pointing to a July release date. The image shows a library card labeled Boys Don't Cry with numerous stamps, implying various due dates. The dates begin with July 2, 2015 and conclude with July 2016 and November 13, 2016. Frank's brother, Ryan Breaux, further suggested this release with an Instagram caption of the same library card photo reading "BOYS DON'T CRY #JULY2016".On August 1, 2016, a live video hosted by Apple Music showing an empty hall was launched on the website boysdontcry.co. The website also featured a new "boysdontcry" graphic. The video marked the first update on the website since a "date due" post from July.
On August 1, 2016, a video appeared that showed Frank Ocean woodworking and sporadically playing instrumentals on loop. That same day, many news outlets reported that August 5, 2016, could be the release date for Boys Don't Cry. The video was revealed to be promotion for Endless, a 45-minute long visual album that began streaming on Apple Music on August 19, 2016.[16]
The following day, Frank posted a new picture on his website advertising four pop-up stores in Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, and London. Later in the day, the album went up on iTunes.

title: Graduation
description: If College Dropout was our introduction and Late Registration a victory lap for a newly anointed champion, then Graduation crystallizes Kanye West's stratospheric success in 24-carat surround sound. Kanye's third album pushes his reflexive rhymes and musical imagination to new places. "Good Life" is a layer cake of silver-gilded synths that lets the listener bask in Kanye's luxurious dream life for three vivid minutes, while the Daft Punk-sampling "Stronger" beams us into a futuristic dance party, awash in neon color.

description:
以新一代的感性与审美，描绘出独属于自己色彩的9位少女——A2O LITE，通过出道数字单曲《NEON》迈出自信而昂扬的一步。同时，《NEON》也代表九位少女“不会停留在此刻闪耀瞬间”的自信宣言。蕴含着她们向梦想之地前进，即便抵达也不会停下脚步，而是望向更远方(Beyond)的抱负。
因为陌生而新鲜，因为古怪而更具魅力的专属于A2O的 Zalpha Pop。
“Neon and beyond that’s what we on and beyond”
《NEON》是 A2O LITE 宣告今后将展开的新色彩与可能性的起点，她们所抵达的更远方会是怎样的世界，不妨拭目以待。清晰展现了 A2O LITE 所主张的Zalpha Pop范式的歌曲。以厚重回荡的贝斯为核心，强烈而中毒性的音效铺展开来，“Neon and beyond”这句反复的歌词贯穿整首歌曲。
尤其是成员们各具个性的演唱、阿卡贝拉以及充满能量的表演相互交融，展现出 A2O LITE 的自信与和谐，蕴含着追随新光芒，向更高、更远迈进的 A2O LITE 的抱负。

title: My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy
description: 100 Best Albums The most expensive hip-hop recording ever made, Kanye West's fifth album was a 68-minute LP pulsing with the rapper's singular mix of the self-aggrandizing and the confessional. The album combined the art-rock ambitions of The Beatles, the opulence of Pink Floyd, and the pop-star grandeur of Michael Jackson—but had the personal gravity of a singer-songwriter statement. There's a nine-minute prog-rap opus ("Runaway") that came with a 35-minute short film. The album art is by contemporary artist and Warhol associate George Condo. "All of the Lights" features an orchestra and vocals from Rihanna, Alicia Keys, and Elton John. But despite its ostentatious appearance, the heart of My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy is that of raw honesty, with West's frayed ends of reflection, self-criticism, relationship woes, ruminations on fame, and moments of anger. My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy would forever change the landscape of hip-hop, its genre-crossing boldness, limitless imagination, and sheer sumptuousness of presentation foreshadowing the genre's 2010s turn towards maximalist sounds and arthouse design.

localized_description.text:
Kanye West 的第五张专辑是 Hip-Hop 史上最豪华的巨作，68 分钟的音乐交织着艺人的自夸和真情告白。这部作品有着 The Beatles 式的艺术摇滚野心，Pink Floyd 式的华丽风格和 Michael Jackson 式的巨星魅力，同时也有着唱作歌手真诚严肃的态度。他为长达 9 分钟的前卫说唱歌曲《Runaway》拍摄了一部 35 分钟的短片；专辑的封面由当代艺术家、曾与 Andy Warhol 共事的 George Condo 创作；《All of the Lights》请来了一整支交响乐团伴奏，更有 Rihanna、Alicia Keys 和 Elton John 献声。

炫目外表之下，《My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy》的核心是赤裸的诚实。West 在专辑中反躬自省、谈及情感创伤、思索名利、倾泻怒火。《My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy》永远地改变了 Hip-Hop 音乐，其跨越类型的大胆尝试、天马行空的想象与华丽至极的表达方式预示着 Hip-Hop 音乐在 2010 年代向极繁主义和视听艺术设计的重大转型。

100 Best Albums The most expensive hip-hop recording ever made, Kanye West's fifth album was a 68-minute LP pulsing with the rapper's singular mix of the self-aggrandizing and the confessional. The album combined the art-rock ambitions of The Beatles, the opulence of Pink Floyd, and the pop-star grandeur of Michael Jackson—but had the personal gravity of a singer-songwriter statement. There's a nine-minute prog-rap opus ("Runaway") that came with a 35-minute short film. The album art is by contemporary artist and Warhol associate George Condo. "All of the Lights" features an orchestra and vocals from Rihanna, Alicia Keys, and Elton John. But despite its ostentatious appearance, the heart of My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy is that of raw honesty, with West's frayed ends of reflection, self-criticism, relationship woes, ruminations on fame, and moments of anger. My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy would forever change the landscape of hip-hop, its genre-crossing boldness, limitless imagination, and sheer sumptuousness of presentation foreshadowing the genre's 2010s turn towards maximalist sounds and arthouse design.

Considéré comme l’enregistrement hip-hop le plus onéreux jamais réalisé, le cinquième album de Kanye West est un disque de 68 minutes où l’on retrouve ce mélange si particulier entre mégalomanie et confession qui caractérise le rappeur. L’album combine les ambitions art-rock des Beatles, l’opulence des Pink Floyd et la grandeur pop de Michael Jackson, tout en conservant la gravité d’une profonde déclaration d’auteur-interprète. Pour accompagner le second single « Runaway », un titre prog-rap de neuf minutes en duo avec Pusha T., Kanye propose un véritable court-métrage de 35 minutes. La pochette de l’album est l’œuvre de l’artiste contemporain George Condo, associé à Warhol. Le morceau « All of the Lights » réunit un orchestre ainsi que les voix de Rihanna, Alicia Keys et Elton John.

Mais malgré son apparente grandiloquence, le cœur de My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy est celui de l’honnêteté brute, composé des fragments de réflexion de Kanye West, son autocritique, ses malheurs relationnels, ses considérations sur la gloire et ses accès de colère. Sur différents aspects My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy changera à jamais le paysage du hip-hop, que ce soit à travers son audace à la croisée des genres, son imagination sans limite ou encore la somptuosité de sa production préfigurant le tournant des années 2010 avec des sonorités maximalistes et un design avant-gardiste.

史上最もお金をかけてレコーディングされたカニエ・ウェストの5作目のアルバムは、計68分にわたり、このラッパーの自己顕示欲と告白が見事に融合した作品となっている。このアルバムは、ビートルズのアートロック的野心と、ピンク・フロイドの豪華さと、マイケル・ジャクソンの気高いポップスター性を併せ持ちながら、シンガーソングライターによる声明という私的な重みも内包していた。そして35分の短編映画を伴った、9分のプログレッシブラップ曲「Runaway (feat. Pusha T)」も収録されていた。アルバムカバーは、アンディ・ウォーホルと関わりのあった現代アーティストであるジョージ・コンドによるものだ。また、「All of the Lights」にはリアーナ、アリシア・キーズ、エルトン・ジョンのボーカルとオーケストラの演奏がフィーチャーされている。

だが、表面的には仰々しく見えるものの、このアルバムの肝は、カニエが内省、自己批判、恋愛の苦悩、名声についての熟考、そして怒りの瞬間を語った生々しい正直さにある。『My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy』は永遠にヒップホップの景観を変え、ジャンルをクロスオーバーする大胆さと無限の想像力、そしてこのジャンルが2010年代にマキシマリスト的サウンドとアートシアター的デザインに方向転換することを予見した完璧で豪華な表現である。

한 시간 넘게 쏟아지는 비트와 자만 가득한 랩. Kanye West의 다섯 번째 앨범 'My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy'는 그 제목에 걸맞게 어둡고, 뒤틀려 있고, 아름답습니다. The Beatles 같은 예술적 야심, Pink Floyd를 연상케 하는 화려함, Michael Jackson처럼 본능적인 팝적 감수성이 하나의 힙합 앨범에 담겨 있죠. 귀에 꽂히는 훅으로 가득한 'All of the Lights', 숨 가쁜 랩이 몰아치는 'Monster', 대서사시와 같은 장렬함이 인상적인 'Runaway' 등 하나하나 귀 기울여 들을 곡으로 가득합니다.

앨범은 음악 외에도 35분짜리 단편 영화로 완성한 'Runaway' 뮤직비디오, 현대 미술가 조지 콘도가 제작한 커버 이미지 등 블록버스터급 화려함을 자랑합니다. 그렇지만 이런 호사스러움만이 앨범의 전부는 아닙니다. 유명 인사의 삶, 섹스와 사랑, 퇴폐와 자기 의심 등의 주제를 망라하는 West의 이야기는 더없이 솔직하며, 그는 이 모든 것을 최고의 음악으로 표현하고자 했습니다. 'My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy'는 그러한 의지가 제대로 구현된 드문 사례 중 하나입니다. 대담한 장르 혼합과 무한한 상상력으로 완성한 이 앨범은 2010년대 힙합의 판도를 완전히 바꿔놓았습니다.

This morning, the words “you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love” appeared on a pink wall on Melrose Avenue in Los Angeles. Turns out, that’s the title of Olivia Rodrigo’s new album. You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love is out June 12 via Geffen. For her follow-up to 2023’s Guts, Rodrigo reunited with producer Dan Nigro, who also worked on her 2021 debut Sour. Check out the cover below.
"No matter how hard I try to write love songs they always come out laced with a little melancholy,” Rodrigo wrote in a message in her fan newsletter. “I am so proud of this record and I can’t wait for you to hear it.”

title: Lost Weekend
description: The return of the one and only Phoebe Bridgers. She is a singer-songwriter from Pasadena, CA. Beloved in equal measure for her deceptively subtle voice and her meticulous, incisive lyrics, her solo records Stranger in the Alps (2017) and Punisher (2020) have been accompanied by a number of collaborations, including the supergroup boygenius, with whom Bridgers won three Grammys for 2023’s the record. Her songs are hallmarked by a kind of intimacy that’s hard-found in contemporary music, and scale between the macro and the micro with an ease that’s matched only by her towering, prodigious way with words.

title: Currents
description:
Tame Impala may have been forged in the familiar fires of guitar-driven psych-rock, but Kevin Parker began expanding that brief almost immediately, shifting from dank, distorted solos to widescreen, synth-swept fantasias. By the time Currents arrived in 2015, the Fremantle home-studio whiz had made his grandest leap yet, offering his particular take on outsized, club-ready pop. That meant mostly sidelining guitars and ramping up the lead role of those synths.
Parker had always made Tame Impala records as a solo endeavor, using a proper band primarily to realize songs in a live setting. Yet this third album saw him applying more painstaking control than ever before, not just playing and writing every single part but recording and mixing the entire thing as well. Even fans who had noticed Parker’s increasing pop sensibilities across 2012’s Lonerism were somewhat taken aback by Currents’ bravura opening statement, “Let It Happen,” an ambitious dance-floor epic that foregrounded glitter-bomb synths and alternately dipping and peaking rhythms. The band’s trajectory changed over the course of a single track, which stretches out over nearly eight minutes and indulges in remix-style record-skipping and lengthy stretches without vocals.
Between the disco grooves, Parker still finds time for Tame Impala’s sonic signatures—floaty vocals, soul-searching lyrics, fleeting interludes. As lush as the production is (which you can hear in the joyous vocal layering and panning on “The Moment”), the increased scope of these songs is matched by the same rich emotional content, making it feel like Parker is sharing his most private moments. From the vulnerability displayed on “Yes I’m Changing,” which muses on growing older against unironic soft-rock motifs, to his interrogations of masculinity and romance on “'Cause I’m a Man,” Parker is still committed to airing intimate, almost diary-like sentiments. Meditative album closer “New Person, Same Old Mistakes” says it all.
Still, Parker doesn’t have to distance himself from formative heroes like Todd Rundgren and The Flaming Lips in the name of artistic growth. Evoking the mirror-ball dazzle of roller rinks and discos, here he continues to cherry-pick from the past in order to imagine a sophisticated musical future that’s appealing across multiple fronts but still strikes directly at the heart. And the risky decision to shelve guitars clearly paid off: Currents took Tame Impala to the big leagues, where he could now collaborate with Lady Gaga, get covered by Rihanna (a version of “New Person, Same Old Mistakes” appeared as “Same Ol’ Mistakes” on 2016’s ANTI), and headline Coachella. It also provided a natural progression to 2020’s The Slow Rush, an even more immersive and personal synth-funk odyssey.

title: U
description: Underscores announces her third album U, via Mom+Pop Music. A self titled album of sorts and the culmination of all her work to date, U draws from the many eras of underscores’ creative trajectory, from dubstep and future bass to jazz chords and guitar driven maximalist pop, forming her most focused, emotionally charged and sharply defined statement yet. Featuring the singles Music, Do It, and Tell Me (U Want It), U further expands the intricate, high impact world she continues to build.
